title: Geometric connectedness can be checked after a field extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-pc-field-extension], let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and let $k'/k$ be a field extension. Regard the base change $X_{k'}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ [def-pc-base-change] as a scheme over $k'$ through its projection to $\operatorname{Spec}k'$. Then $X$ is geometrically connected over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] if and only if $X_{k'}$ is geometrically connected over $k'$.
